title: ci: the push-to-main CI run is cancelled by the next merge 9 times in 13, so the Turbo cache seed that only that run saves goes stale and every PR shard and lint lane rebuilds cold (Build Core 51 s → 4m30s, shard closures Σ 20–31 runner-min per run)
body:
Ruled: 6366946328 · batch #5 item 1 · letter C · 2026-10-23T14:13:20Z (「同意」 — the staged per-push concurrency change lands as a coverage fix and a separate cache-pool card is filed; the premise below was falsified by the card thread, see the ruling comment)

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task (CI performance programme, 2026-10-23). Reader: the `domain:devx` execution seat, dispatch step — one os-dev, one PR touching `ci.yml` and `lint.yml` together. Dedup: `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included, "Turbo cache save main only push cancelled cancel-in-progress seed stale cold build" → 3 hits, all closed (#21193, #5401, #11907); none open. #5401 (closed) explained the same symptom by timing — a queue entry within 4 min of a main merge; this card names the cancellation that keeps the seed from ever being written. Session: `session_01GVTBi44LAWbPWg4evKfE1T`.

## One-sentence problem

~~The only CI run allowed to save objectstack's Turbo build cache is the one that runs on a push to main, and that run is cancelled by the next merge in roughly two of every three merges, so pull requests and queue builds restore a stale seed and rebuild the dependency closure cold in six shards and three lint lanes at once.~~

Struck by the ruling (comment 6366946328): the save steps are `if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'` and run when the job is cancelled, so the seed is written (cancelled run 39923516471 saved all six shard seeds). The change below lands for a different reason — every push-to-main run finishes its own `--affected` Test Core, so each merge has a verdict (31 of 40 push runs on 2026-10-23 were cancelled mid-run; corrected from 32 by the card thread). The speed cause moves to the sibling cache-pool card.

## Evidence (file lines at objectstack commit 303aef0; runs from the GitHub Actions API, 2026-10-22 16:25Z → 10-23 03:50Z)

- `ci.yml:88-90` — `concurrency.group` is `ci-` + workflow + event name + (the PR number, else `github.ref`), with `cancel-in-progress: true`. For a push to main every run shares the group `ci-CI-push-refs/heads/main`, so the next merge cancels the previous main run. `lint.yml:98-100` is the same shape.
- `ci.yml:1397-1402` — "Save Turbo cache (main only)", `if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'`; the same gate at `ci.yml:2750` (Build Core) and `lint.yml:5929` (typecheck). PR and merge_group runs are restore-only and fall back through `restore-keys` prefixes (`ci.yml:602-610`).
- `ci.yml:74-76` already records 36 of 60 push runs cancelled. Fresh sample: of 13 push-to-main CI runs in 3.4 h, 9 were cancelled (Lint 8/12, CodeQL 8/12). The merge cadence (median inter-merge ≈ 8.8–16 min) is shorter than the ≈ 28 min full run, so the Save step at the end of the job rarely executes.
- Cold vs warm, in-tree measurements: Build Core 51 s warm → 4m30s cold (`ci.yml:595`); workspace build 4 s → 4m54s (`lint.yml:5107-5109`); a lint lane's in-lane build 332 s (`lint.yml:6659`).
- Fresh per-job sample: PR run 39891259937 (Turbo restore 0 s = miss) — shard closure builds 3.1–6.0 min each, Σ ≈ 31 runner-min, Build Core 6.45 min, run wall 36.4 min; PR run 39893808670 (warm) — closures 0–1.7 min, Σ ≈ 6, Build Core 2.0 min, wall 28.4; merge_group 39894014103 — closures 3.0–3.4 min each. Ten jobs per PR build the closure independently (6 shards, Build Core, 3 lint typecheck lanes); only the main seed can make them warm.

## Governing text

- AGENTS.md lines 371–372 ("Nor the build cache — turbo resolves the repo root through the common dir, so every worktree replays ONE `.turbo/cache`") is about local worktrees; CI's seed discipline lives in `ci.yml:598-610` and `lint.yml:5140-5145`, which this card changes only in when the seed is written, not in what it contains.
- `ci.yml:88-90`'s own comment explains the group shape; the PR rewrites that comment with the new rule.

## Change (the dev picks one, measures, and pins it in the PR)

- ~~(a) Make `cancel-in-progress` an expression that is false for the push event and true otherwise, in both `ci.yml` and `lint.yml`, so every main run completes and saves; or~~
- ~~(b) Give the seed-saving jobs (`test`, `build-core`, the lint typecheck lanes) a push-only concurrency group that never cancels, and keep cancellation for the rest of the push run.~~
- Ruled (comment 6366946328): the staged change on branch `claude/project-thread-9d8u29` @ 535ff7a lands — `github.event.after` joins the concurrency group in `ci.yml` and `lint.yml`, so each push to main has its own group (a `cancel-in-progress: false` alone still loses 18 of 40 runs, since GitHub keeps one pending run per group), and `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --check-concurrency` covers the five run contexts.
- Either way the PR states the expected runner cost: the previously cancelled share (≈ 100 runner-min per merge at today's full-battery size) now runs to completion. Moving the push-only full battery (temporal, dogfood ×3, verify, console-pin, the lint slow tier) off the push event to schedule/dispatch is a separate card the lane may file; it is not in this one.

## Acceptance

Rewritten to the coverage reading per the ruling (comment 6366946328); the shard-closure / Build Core speed acceptance moved to the sibling card #25452.

- Over ≥ 10 consecutive merges to main after landing, every push run's own Test Core completes, and no push CI run is cancelled by its successor (baseline 2026-10-23: 31 of 40 push runs cancelled).
- Guard: over the next 10 PR runs, the median runner queue wait stays ≤ 1 min; otherwise revert.
- Cost stated in the PR: about +85 runner-min per merge (estimate), upper bound +183 (CI + Lint).

## Risks

- Runner-minutes rise by the no-longer-cancelled share; GitHub-hosted runner queue wait is ≈ 0 today (≤ 6 s over ~140 jobs), so no latency cost.
- The 10 GB Actions cache pool: Build Docs saves its Next cache on PRs too (`ci.yml:2792-2798`), which evicts seeds — the dev notes it, a sibling card may fix it.
- Option (a) lets two main runs overlap; the seed key carries `github.sha` so they do not collide.

## Work estimate

Lane `domain:devx` · 1 PR (.github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/lint.yml) · precedent: the concurrency block's last change is beyond this depth-50 clone; no +/− lines to cite. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · Tier H (governed surface — the PR waits for a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval before ready).

Prior rulings read: turbo, cache, cancel-in-progress, seed → docs/adr 30 hits, AGENTS.md 17 hits (all on local worktree cache and build commands, none on the CI seed cadence); ADR none; thread: none.

Related: #5401 (closed), #22077 (closed), #21186 (closed), #11907 (closed).

## Maintainer directive (verbatim, untranslated)

> 同意，立卡

— the maintainer, 2026-10-23, in reply to the director seat's offer 「(a) 我按 PM 流程把 A1–A5、B1–B3 立成卡进队列(英文卡面、带 Governing text: 与工作量列),由 os-dev 派发」. The CI performance analysis those letters index is the seat's 2026-10-23 five-line audit (objectstack ci.yml + lint.yml; the other 39 workflows; the repo-side turbo/vitest/gate configuration; objectui's 28 workflows; GitHub Actions run data for the preceding 5–55 hours). The maintainer's stated goal, verbatim: 「我希望优化的是性能和效率速度」.
